captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a parking garage barrier gate. It features a dark grey rectangular housing box that acts as the base, topped with a hinge mechanism. Attached to this hinge is a long, tapered rectangular boom arm, colored white with alternating red warning stripes. The boom arm rotates upward on a single horizontal revolute joint to simulate the opening and closing movement of a security gate.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a parking garage barrier gate. The model must include a dark grey rectangular housing base and a long, tapered boom arm colored white with red warning stripes. The boom arm should be connected to the top of the housing via a horizontal revolute joint to allow realistic rotational opening and closing movement.
captions.factory: The code constructs the barrier using two main parts: a base housing and a rotating boom arm. The base is created using a box primitive for the main cabinet, styled with a dark grey material. The boom arm is constructed from a series of connected box primitives of decreasing cross-section to create a tapered look, with alternating white and red materials. A revolute joint (articulation) is defined near the top-rear of the housing, aligning along a horizontal axis to allow the boom arm to rotate vertically.
